[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Kinesiology - Pre-Occupational Therapy Emphasis, B.S.","groupId":"e067e5fb-d006-44cc-9ee1-01929208e49e","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

ABOUT THE MAJOR

The pre-occupational therapy emphasis contains basic pre-professional preparation for graduate work at other institutions with occupational therapy programs. Completion of work at these graduate programs will ultimately lead to licensure in occupational therapy. Each graduate program has special requirements that may vary between programs. Students should contact the school(s) of their choice during their sophomore year at FPU and work closely with their program advisor in selecting the appropriate courses within this emphasis. In some instances, it may be necessary to take a specific course at another institution to meet a certain requirement of a given graduate program. Also, some students may need to take more than the minimum number of emphasis units in order to meet the entry requirements of the selected graduate program.


EMPHASIS COURSES

Students in the Pre-Occupational Therapy Emphasis will complete at least 21 units of emphasis electives. See catalog for details.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
